create.name: Green Mountain Zen
create.bio:
Green Mountain Zen is a Soto Zen practice community in Wellington, New Zealand, guided by Philip Shinko Squire Roshi. Shinko grew up in Wellington and trained full-time for a decade from 1994 at Yokoji Zen Mountain Center, California; Charles Tenshin Fletcher Roshi, the abbot there, gave him Dharma transmission in 2006 and final inka in 2016. The sangha is affiliated with Yokoji and belongs to the White Plum Asanga of teachers in Maezumi Roshi's lineage.

The group has no building of its own. It sits together every Thursday evening at the Quaker Meeting House in Mount Victoria, with chanting, two periods of zazen, walking meditation and a talk or discussion, and offers a short introduction to Zen for newcomers on the first Thursday of each month. Early-morning sittings run online three days a week, a longer Sunday morning sit with lunch is held monthly at Breaker Bay, and twice a year the community goes on a five-day silent sesshin near Otaki. Members can follow a training path that includes the lay precepts and koan study, and recordings of Shinko Roshi's sesshin talks are free on the site.

courses.title: Sesshin (Meditation Retreat)
courses.description: A five-day silent Zen retreat from Tuesday evening to Sunday midday at a retreat house near Otaki, opening with a ceremony and built around zazen, with walking, chanting, meals, rest, Dharma talks and work practice in between.

courses.title: Membership and training paths
courses.description: Membership for those who want to practise regularly with the sangha and enter a teacher–student relationship, with a small financial commitment, discounts on activities and a path that can lead on to receiving the precepts and senior training.

free_resources.title: Shinko Roshi's sesshin dharma talks
free_resources.description: Audio recordings of talks given on the community's retreats from 2016 onwards, on themes such as impermanence, Bodhidharma and Huike, Rinzai's true person and the Four Noble Truths, free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Introduction to Zen
free_resources.description: A free half-hour introduction to Zen meditation for complete beginners, held on the first Thursday of each month before the regular evening sitting; sign up through the contact form.
